Sr. Mechanical Engineer (Materials & Corrosion)

83780 Posted: 12/08/2026
  • Market related
  • Middle East

Sr. Mechanical Engineer (Materials & Corrosion)

Working Location

Doha, Qatar

Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree: Mechanical or Metallurgical Engineering
  • Professional status: Chartered Engineer / Professional Engineer status or equivalent is preferable

Experience

  • 10 years relevant post-graduate experience, including 6 years related to the Oil & Gas industry
  • Ability to identify and use relevant engineering standards and codes related to Materials & Corrosion Engineering
  • Proven ability to manage time, cost, and quality in engineering projects within a multiple-project environment
  • Good communication and presentation skills with fluency in English

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical design and engineering services in Materials & Corrosion Engineering for assigned projects, meeting technical quality requirements while considering schedule, cost, and HSE
  • Conduct Materials & Corrosion Engineering activities and in-house site surveys from concept definition through engineering studies, FEED, detailed design, and commissioning
  • Ensure technical assurance practices, engineering standards, environmental and safety policies are incorporated and followed; review technical deviations/variations
  • Support review, update, and application of internal engineering standards and amendments to external standards
  • Plan and coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams for timely delivery of technical services
  • Coordinate engineering designs and develop/review multidisciplinary work scopes, ensuring completeness and clarity
  • Review and approve contractor method statements for scope compliance and resolve technical issues
  • Develop, update, and monitor in-house engineering schedules and contribute to FEED/EPIC scheduling and effective delivery
  • Evaluate technical bid packages for scope compliance
  • Review and evaluate contract changes/variations to approved guidelines and practices
  • Support development of personal and coworker technical competency and participate in structured training for Associate Engineers
